name: House wrap
description: Spun-bonded polyolefin weather-resistive barrier over wall sheathing. Fastened with cap nails; the roofing-nail joint stands in for them.
source: DuPont Tyvek HomeWrap product information: basis weight 1.8 oz/yd² (TAPPI T-410), ≈0.0125 psf

name: Aluminum flashing
description: Aluminum roll and step flashing at roof-wall joints, windows and penetrations.
source: Approximate: computed for 0.019in aluminum sheet at 169 pcf (no published weight); 5in K-style gutter in 0.027in stock is about 0.38 lb/ft

name: Flashing tape
description: 4in self-adhered butyl or acrylic flashing tape around window and door openings. Self-adhered; the roofing-nail joint stands in for its attachment.
source: Approximate: a 4in × 75ft butyl flashing tape roll weighs about 3 lb (no published areal weight)

name: Engineered wood lap siding
description: Engineered wood lap siding (LP SmartSide type), primed, 8in boards at about 7in exposure.
source: LP SmartSide architect brochure, 38 Series Cedar Texture Lap, 8in: 1.5 psf

name: Board-and-batten siding
description: Engineered wood 4x8 vertical siding panels with battens over the joints.
source: Approximate: taken as LP SmartSide 38 Series lap (1.5 psf; LP architect brochure); panels use the same 3/8in substrate

name: Fiber cement lap siding
description: Fiber cement lap siding (HardiePlank type), 8 1/4in boards at 7in exposure. Non-combustible and rot-proof, but heavy.
source: James Hardie HardiePlank spec sheet SS2001: 2.31 lb per sq ft

name: PVC trim board
description: Cellular PVC trim (AZEK type) in 1x4, 1x6 and 1x8: corners, window and door casing. Won't rot.
source: AZEK trim CSI specification (2023): density 0.55 g/cm³ (ASTM D792), ≈34.3 pcf

name: Primed pine trim board
description: Primed finger-jointed pine in 1x4, 1x6 and 1x8: painted exterior trim.
source: USDA Wood Handbook FPL-GTR-282 (2021) Table 5-3a: ponderosa pine SG 0.40 at 12% moisture, ≈28 pcf

name: Vented vinyl soffit
description: Vented vinyl soffit panels under the eaves, 12in wide.
source: ProSpan vinyl soffit data sheet: 75.73 lb per 2-square carton, ≈0.38 psf

name: Primed pine fascia board
description: Primed pine fascia in 1x6 or 1x8 along the rafter tails.
source: USDA Wood Handbook FPL-GTR-282 (2021) Table 5-3a: ponderosa pine SG 0.40 at 12% moisture, ≈28 pcf
